descriptionByLocale.en:
Become part of our dedicated kitchen team and contribute to the daily catering of patients and employees. You can expect a versatile job in a modern hospital environment as well as a motivated team.<br/ >The University Hospital Zurich is one of the largest hospitals in Switzerland. Our more than 8,600 employees and around 700 trainees work every day for the well-being of our patients. Tasks:
• Supports production in the preparation of cold and warm food for patients:inside and employees:inside
• Monitor and prepare meals
• Cold diet kitchen
• Compliance with quality standards, hygiene and occupational safety guidelines
• Precise implementation of recipes (allergen management)
• A role model for our learners Requirements
• Advantageous degree as a kitchen employee:r EBA
• Experience from a large kitchen is an advantage
• Operational readiness, high load capacity and flexibility
• Interest in healthy food/food
• Professional pride is evident
• Passion for the daily professional challenge
• German in Word and Writing
• Motivated, resilient, flexible and capable of teamwork, coupled with high service orientation and a dose of humor We offer: We offer you a varied activity, area of responsibility in a professional and modern working environment. With us you will find a structured working day with the guarantee that you have free work every second weekend. A motivated team will always support you with your questions and your work.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
